dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped marks feature jagged, high-contrast light-toned perimeters. The geometry of the largest central annulus is amoeboid, with a sharp contrast gradient between the dark background fur and the lighter-colored perimeter ring.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of localized, solid high-intensity white spots concentrated near the left margin and the base of the flipper, appearing as pixel-dense clusters without internal shading.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest central annuli form an obtuse triangle, while smaller peripheral annuli form a linear chain extending toward the lower left boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Superior flipper displays five prominent, dark-pigmented claws with visible sharp tips and distinct spacing between digits.
